privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information.

sections.p: We collect the details you provide when requesting a quote or submitting documents, such as your name, contact information, and the files you choose to share with us.
Your information is used solely to prepare quotes, assign qualified translators, deliver completed work, and respond to your enquiries.
All documents are stored securely and access is limited to the linguists directly assigned to your project. Files are retained only as long as necessary to complete and support your order.
We do not sell your personal information. Documents are only shared with vetted translators and reviewers bound by confidentiality agreements.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting our team.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: The terms governing use of our services.

sections.p: By requesting a quote or placing an order, you agree to the terms outlined on this page.
Turnaround times provided at quotation are estimates based on document length, complexity, and language pair, and begin once payment and source files are confirmed.
Clients are responsible for providing accurate source material and for reviewing final deliverables for context-specific requirements.
Ownership of translated content transfers to the client upon full payment, excluding any pre-existing translation memories or glossaries retained for quality purposes.
Our liability for any claim relating to a project is limited to the fees paid for that specific translation.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.subtitle: Our approach to revisions, refunds, and satisfaction.

sections.p: If a delivered translation does not meet the agreed brief, we offer free revisions within 7 days of delivery at no additional cost.
Refunds may be issued for cancelled projects prior to translator assignment, or where delivered work materially fails to meet the agreed scope after revision attempts.
Completed and delivered certified translations that meet the original brief are not eligible for refund once accepted by the relevant authority.
To request a revision or refund, contact our support team with your order reference within 14 days of delivery.
